1–2 hours (freeing) + as long as you like putting out fires

In Shadowthorn, the elves who refused to worship the bog god set fire to the village and were locked up in three underground prisons. If you kill the guards and all the elves, the prisons open and, the next day, Shadowthorn is on fire. You put out the fires with swamp water from the bog god's temple: 500 fires give the achievement **Firefighter** and, with luck, a Thornfire Wolf appears that you can turn into the {item:Crystal Wolf (Mount)|Crystal Wolf} mount.
Pyro Peter, in Venore (reports the state of Shadowthorn)

With Shadowthorn on fire, each fire you put out has a small chance of making a {creature:Thornfire Wolf} appear: lure it to the {item:Bog Water} at the bog god's temple to turn it into a {creature:Crystal Wolf} and tame it with the {item:Diapason}.
